news.title: Global Energy Import Dependence Set to Peak by 2034, Rystad Says
news.summary: Rystad Energy’s fifth edition of its flagship annual report, Global Energy Scenarios (GES) 2026, finds that global reliance on imported energy is projected to peak by 2034 as energy security concerns accelerate the shift towards electrification. news.title: EIA expects a mixed picture for winter fuel costs this year
news.summary: In the 2026-27 Winter Fuels Outlook, released alongside the October Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO), the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) expects U.S. households that primarily heat with natural gas or propane - about half of households - will spend less on energy expenses this winter than last winter.
